name: 강옥순

appearance_en.face_shape: weathered oval face, moderate cheekbones, jaw slightly heavy from age — a face that has been getting up at 4am for 40 years and shows every one of them
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, deeply weathered from 40 years of outdoor market work, wind and sun damage visible, deep nasolabial folds, horizontal forehead lines, rough texture — the face of physical labour
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown tired eyes, heavy-lidded, outer corners drooped significantly — a gaze that has watched customers walk past for three months and knows what it means
appearance_en.nose: medium broad nose, slightly flat, sturdy — matches the working face
appearance_en.mouth: thin-medium lips, corners pulled very slightly downward — not in sadness, in the habitual expression of someone calculating whether today's take will cover tomorrow's cost. The mouth that says '장사가 안 돼' without drama because it has said it so many times it is simply true
appearance_en.eyebrows: medium sparse brows gone mostly grey, slightly downward outer angle — the brow of accumulated quiet defeat
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep weathering lines across forehead and cheeks, rough skin at hands visible at edges of frame, age spots at temples
appearance_en.hair: short grey permed hair, practical and low-maintenance — she has not had time for anything else in 40 years

body.proportions: compact sturdy frame, hands thickened from decades of handling produce, shoulders slightly rounded from early-morning set-up work
body.posture: slightly forward stoop from decades of market work, hands often in front as if still arranging produce — the body memory of 40 years of the same motion
body.body_prompt: 156cm compact sturdy Korean grandmother, slight forward market-work stoop, rounded shoulders, hands carrying the memory of 40 years of labour

default.description: plain dark work apron over simple blouse, practical trousers, worn flat shoes — market seller working clothes, functional and unremarkable
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain dark work apron over simple blouse, practical dark trousers, worn flat shoes

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: quiet exhausted resignation — not despair, not anger, just the face of a woman who has run the numbers one last time and arrived at the same answer
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 74-year-old Korean market grandmother, weathered oval face with deep nasolabial folds and forehead lines, heavy-lidded tired dark eyes with significantly drooped outer corners, sparse grey brows with downward angle, medium broad nose, thin-medium lips with slightly downturned corners, short practical grey permed hair, 156cm compact sturdy rounded-shoulder frame, medium-dark heavily weathered outdoor Korean skin

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean manga ink lines, muted earthy screen tone, warm-grey palette, cinematic Korean drama composition, 40 years of quiet labour in every line, dignity in exhaustion
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, cheerful, young, glamorous, soft features
